title: Fix two data-loss bugs in persistent projects: unawaited unload flush + Save-As autosave race
description: FIXED both data-loss bugs (task 1316). BUG 1 (unload durability): useProjectActions unload effect flushes durably on visibilitychange->hidden (page still alive), serializing the pending doc SYNCHRONOUSLY via new AutosaveController.takePendingPayload() and STARTING the IndexedDB write in-handler; pagehide backstop; blur proactive flush. Documented best-effort residual. BUG 2 (Save-As race): AutosaveController captures {bytes,targetName,generation} at fire/schedule time (target no longer read at persist-resolve); explicit Save/Save As/Open call supersede() (generation bump) dropping stale autosaves; defense-in-depth monotonic per-slot seq in ProjectStore.put rejects strictly-older writes. VERIFY: packages build PASS; authoring-ui tests = 76 files/993 PASS. Regression: autosaveSaveAsRace.test.ts + projectStore seq-guard + controller supersede/target/takePendingPayload tests. Docs: docs/35-persistent-projects.md.
